SELECT m.normalized_symbol AS symbol,
            m.provider_symbol,m.identity_status,m.group_id FROM stock_watchlist_members m
            JOIN stock_watchlist_groups g ON g.group_id=m.group_id
            WHERE m.status='active' AND g.is_active=1 ORDER BY m.normalized_symbol,m.group_id
SELECT symbol,state,reason,checked_at FROM one_minute_prewarm WHERE session='2026-10-16' ORDER BY symbol

SELECT p.state,COUNT(*) FROM one_minute_history_pages p
            JOIN one_minute_prewarm w ON w.symbol=p.symbol AND w.session='2026-10-16'
            WHERE p.session>='2026-09-18' AND p.session<'2026-10-16' AND w.state!='IDENTITY_UNRESOLVED'
            GROUP BY p.state
SELECT MAX(bar_end),MAX(created_at) FROM one_minute_evaluations WHERE session='2026-10-16'

SELECT e.payload_json FROM one_minute_evaluations e JOIN (
                SELECT rowid AS evidence_rowid, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                    PARTITION BY symbol,right_name ORDER BY created_at DESC,rowid DESC
                ) AS rank_at_bar
                FROM one_minute_evaluations
                WHERE session='2026-10-16' AND bar_end='2026-10-16T19:59:00+00:00'

            ) ranked ON e.rowid=ranked.evidence_rowid WHERE rank_at_bar=1
